text: Made like brown butter, only cooked darker, then stopped with an acid. No temperature or time is given in the source; the colour is the guide.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Until the water has evaporated and the butter is dark, past brown butter.
Vinegar, lemon juice or white wine (capers also) stirred in after the cooking, and parsley at the end.
